title: Web app
description: The app in a browser, served by `lathe serve` or the dev server: the Reader and the Owner read, trace and edit the spec on its pages.

title: Desktop app
description: The macOS app: the same pages in a window of their own, with native menus, Lathe's own title bar, the Dock and the file manager.

title: CLI
description: The `lathe` command and the package scripts, run in a terminal by the Owner or by an Agent: each step runs the CLI command that exposes its command or query.

title: MCP tools
description: The Claude Code plugin's MCP tools, skills and hooks, which an Agent uses to write and check a spec through the command layer.

title: HTTP API
description: The local server's JSON API under /api, which the app calls and which refuses requests from other sites.

title: Package API
description: The package's exports in code, such as loadWorkspace and openStore, which an Agent's script calls.
